PHYSICAL INTERPRETATION:
The 2001VO24 data represents resonant proton scattering measurements. The 
CSV matrix contained transitions to many unobserved intermediate compound 
nuclear states. In the ENSDF adopted level scheme (which consolidates data 
from multiple measurement techniques), many of these intermediate states are 
not confirmed. Therefore, only transitions to established adopted levels 
(ground state and the few known excited states common to all data sources) 
have been retained.

The corrected file now reflects the intersection of 2001VO24 data with the 
established adopted level scheme, ensuring consistency and data integrity.
